# Second Nature Labs

> Second Nature Labs builds expert-verified, physics-grounded RL environments and cheat-resistant evals for AI that must reason about and act in the physical world.

Second Nature Labs sells training environments and evaluation benchmarks for physical AI
to AI labs and robotics companies. Environments are simulation-grounded — 100% computed
physics (resistance networks, V = I×R, seeded noise), zero hand-authored sensor values —
and expert-verified: a human domain expert plays each environment and catches physics bugs
that pass automated test suites.

## Products

- [no-start-env](https://github.com/Jaiparmar940/rlenv): Inspect-native agentic RL
  environment and benchmark. LLM agents diagnose simulated vehicle electrical no-start and
  charging faults using realistic shop tools, scored by a cheat-resistant 0–100 grader
  (root cause 60 / parts discipline 25 / time efficiency 15; fixes must be verified by a
  successful engine start).

## Benchmark results (2026-07, 9 models, 25 episodes per model)

- Mean scores /100: claude-fable-5 86.0, gpt-5.5 82.3, grok-4 74.9, claude-sonnet-5 74.5,
  gemini-3.5-flash 59.7, claude-haiku-4-5 39.9, ministral-3b 23.0, qwen-2.5-7b 20.9,
  llama-3.1-8b 7.2.
- Frontier models have cleared textbook short-horizon automotive diagnosis; the hard tier
  (intermittent CAN fault, compound battery+ground fault) is not saturated — no model
  passes every episode.
